title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-05
source: SBD > REEL > REEL > DAT > SP/DIF > HD > SHN

ai_review.summary: A crisp sound‑board recording captures one of the hottest 1969 shows – acoustic Dupree into Mountains > Dark Star, a smoking St Stephen > Lovelight, and an electrifying Eleven.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this near‑perfect performance, highlighting the seamless acoustic‑to‑electric flow, the transcendent Dark Star suite, and the powerhouse renditions of St Stephen > Lovelight and The Eleven. The SBD source is praised as clear, sweet and full of “oomph,” making the show sound alive even decades later.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and recording quality indicate an exceptional show with excellent soundboard clarity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the board as crisp, sweet, clear and more detailed than other copies; no major issues reported.

standout_songs: Mountains of the Moon > Dark Star
show_quality.setlist_flow: Seamless transition from acoustic material into electric jams, building intensity with strong segues and a cohesive, high‑energy arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sharp, on‑the‑edge playing and perfect guitar tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen noted for laying down solid organ parts; no specific keyboard praise beyond that.
